summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 5 (Vendor CMT Portal) and Phase 2 (WIP/FG Unification). All backend APIs and frontend UI flows are working correctly. Vendor portal allows vendors to login, view assigned jobs, and submit progress reports. Phase 2 WIP/FG unification successfully creates inventory entries in rahaza_material_stock. Phase 1-4 Maklon PO regression tests passed.
